content.comment_body: Hello, how do I register if I am a private individual? I don't have a company like sro, ltd, gmbh... I am using a translator since I don't speak English.
This is an English-speaking forum. Please kindly write your posts in English. If you don't speak English, please use a translation program. For the 'Company' field, simply enter 'Private use.'

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unsure how to complete the registration process when not representing a company, highlighting a lack of clear instructions for individuals. The confusion centers on how to fill out the 'Company' field, especially for private users. Language barriers are also affecting the user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy registration process as a private individual, without needing to provide company details and with clear guidance for non-business users.
